login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in to access your personal panel for routine, finances, goals and progress.
login.invalidCredentials: Invalid email or password. Check your information and try again.
login.requiredFields: Fill in your email and password to continue.
login.heroTitle: Your life organized in a central panel.
login.heroDescription: Finances, routine, goals, habits and personal progress connected in a simple, visual and responsive experience.
login.footer: Organize your life, track your progress and make better decisions.
login.capitalStart: Start by registering your current assets.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: Start building your personal panel for finances, routine, goals and progress.
signup.name: Name
signup.passwordMin: The password must have at least 6 characters.
signup.passwordMismatch: Passwords do not match. Check and try again.
signup.genericError: We couldn't create your account right now. Check your information and try again.
signup.heroTitle: Turn your routine into a system.
signup.heroDescription: WstSide centralizes your finances, habits, goals and personal progress in one place.
signup.footer: Create your personal base to organize finances, routine and goals.
signup.firstStepDescription: After that, we'll configure your assets, routine and goals.

forgotPassword.title: Reset password
forgotPassword.description: Enter your email and we'll send a link for you to create a new password.
forgotPassword.genericError: We couldn't send the recovery email right now. Check the email and try again.
forgotPassword.successDescription: We sent the instructions to reset your password.
forgotPassword.successCardDescription: If the email is registered, you'll receive a link to create a new password.
forgotPassword.notFoundDescription: Check your inbox, promotions, spam or trash. The email may take a few minutes to arrive.
forgotPassword.heroTitle: Get back in control of your routine.
forgotPassword.heroDescription: Request a secure link to reset your password and continue using WstSide normally.
forgotPassword.footer: Recover your access and return to your personal panel.
forgotPassword.securityDescription: You'll receive a link to create a new password securely.

updatePassword.title: Create new password
updatePassword.description: Enter your new password to recover access to WstSide.
updatePassword.passwordMin: The new password must have at least 6 characters.
updatePassword.passwordMismatch: Passwords do not match. Check and try again.
updatePassword.genericError: We couldn't update your password. Request a new recovery link and try again.
updatePassword.securityTipDescription: Use a password with letters, numbers and symbols. Avoid reusing passwords from other services.
updatePassword.heroDescription: Create a new password to return to your personal system for finances, routine, goals and progress.
updatePassword.footer: Set a secure new password to continue using your panel.
updatePassword.protectionDescription: Use a strong password that is different from your old passwords.

signUpSuccess.title: Confirm your email
signUpSuccess.description: Your account has been created. Now confirm your email to unlock access to WstSide.
signUpSuccess.inboxDescription: We sent a confirmation link to your registered email. Click the link to activate your account before signing in.
signUpSuccess.notFoundDescription: Check promotions, spam or trash. Delivery may take a few minutes depending on your provider.
signUpSuccess.heroTitle: The first step of your personal system is done.
signUpSuccess.heroDescription: Confirm your email and start building your center for finances, routine, goals and progress.
signUpSuccess.footer: After confirmation, you'll be able to access your personal panel.
signUpSuccess.nextStepDescription: After confirming your email, you'll be allowed to enter WstSide's private environment.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: We couldn't complete this authentication step.
error.actionFailedDescription: The link may have expired, the session may no longer be active, or the request may be invalid.
error.unspecifiedDescription: No error code was provided. Try starting the flow again.
error.heroTitle: Let's get your access back on track.
error.heroDescription: Some authentication links have limited validity. When that happens, just start the flow again.
error.footer: If the problem continues, generate a new link or try signing in again.
error.recommendedPathDescription: Go back to login or request a new recovery link.
